record.body:
## Description

R10: `scripts/test.sh` passes.

The closing verification failed: two modules that use the installed prefix fixture collide on `<tmp>/source` (FileExistsError).

## Approach

In tests/test_cli_packaging.py `_source_tree` create the source directory with `tempfile.mkdtemp(dir=prefix.parent, prefix="source-")` instead of a fixed name.

payload.title: Give each installed fixture its own source directory

record.subject: fix-installed-source-dir
